title: Refactor Code Result
description: Return of the refactor-code agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject and the files it changed, which pb checkpoint --step refactor commits as one fix group once the task's tests pass

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question, or an issue the agent could not fix without changing behaviour, or an empty string

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified
